statement: A business that sells or shares consumers' personal information, or uses or discloses consumers' sensitive personal information for purposes other than those authorized by § 1798.121(a), must provide, in a form reasonably accessible to consumers, a link titled 'Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information' and a link titled 'Limit the Use of My Sensitive Personal Information' (or, at its discretion, a single clearly labeled homepage link serving both); the business is excused from those links if it instead allows consumers to exercise both rights through an opt-out preference signal meeting the technical specifications of regulations adopted under § 1798.185(a)(19) (Civ. Code § 1798.135(a)(1)-(3), (b)(1)).
caveat: The CPPA's regulations carry the opt-out preference signal's technical specifications and the display and request-handling mechanics, and the rest of § 1798.135 sets out how opt-out requests are honored and when consent can be re-requested. Statutory text verified on the FindLaw mirror; confirm against leginfo.legislature.ca.gov before relying. This repo does not determine whether a business sells or shares personal information.
